All services

PCAB-licensed engineering, construction, environmental, and marine services.

From land development and reclamation to ports, industrial plants, water treatment, and full marine logistics. ECE Construction Services holds a Regular Contractor's License from the Philippine Contractors Accreditation Board (PCAB).

01 — construction

Engineering & Construction (Horizontal & Vertical)

PCAB-licensed horizontal and vertical engineering works — from land development and reclamation to ports, industrial plants, and full civil/electrical/mechanical scopes.

Land Development & Housing Works

Site grading, road networks, drainage, subdivision development, and housing construction.

Reclamation Projects

Coastal and offshore land reclamation with dredging, filling, and ground improvement.

Ports & Bridges

Port facilities, wharves, bridges, and marine infrastructure for commercial and industrial use.

Shipyards

Shipyard construction, dry-dock facilities, and marine repair infrastructure.

Industrial & Manufacturing Plant Construction

Cement, sugar, power, and manufacturing plant construction from foundation to commissioning.

Structural Steel Fabrication & Installation

Heavy steel fabrication and erection for industrial and commercial structures.

Commercial Buildings & Civil Works

Office, retail, mixed-use, and warehouse construction with full civil-works scope.

Electrical Works

Industrial and commercial electrical systems, substation, and power distribution.

Mechanical / Electromechanical Engineering

Mechanical installation, HVAC, plumbing, and electromechanical systems.

Cooling System / Ventilation Installation

Industrial cooling, ventilation, and air-handling system design and installation.

Water Treatment Facilities

Wastewater treatment plants, water filtration, and supply systems.

Deep Well & Water Supply Filtration

Deep-well drilling, pump installation, and water treatment/filtration systems.

Surveying & Designing

Topographic, hydrographic, and cadastral surveying; engineering design.

Mineral Processing Plant Installation

Crushing, screening, washing, and mineral beneficiation plant construction.
02 — environmental

Environmental Protection

Wastewater treatment, deep-well water filtration, and environmental consulting services aligned with the company's mission to protect the environment.

Waste Water Treatment

Design, construction, and operation of industrial and municipal wastewater treatment plants.

Deep Well & Water Filtration

Deep-well construction and water filtration systems for industrial and community use.

Environmental Consultation

Environmental impact assessment, permitting, and compliance consulting.
03 — marine

Marine Services

Full-spectrum marine logistics — LCT and tug & barge charter, vessel piling barge, and crane cutter suction / 3-in-1 dredger services for ports, reclamation, and shore protection.

LCT / Tug & Barge

Landing craft tank and tug-and-barge charter for bulk cargo and project cargo transport.

Vessel Piling Barge

Piling barge for wharf, bridge, and marine foundation piling works.

Crane Cutter Suction / 3-in-1 Dredger

Hydraulic cutter suction dredging for port deepening, reclamation, and channel maintenance.

Marine Survey

Hydrographic and bathymetric surveys for marine projects.
